summary: Spawns a homing projectile that travels to the target.
overview: The physical alternative to hitscan: spawns a TDProjectile that travels and homes. Slower to land, and visibly so, which is the point.
useCases: Cannon, arrow or mortar towers with visible shots.
Attacks where travel time is part of the balance.
Towers that should visibly miss a very fast enemy.

params.tuning: Required, and must have a TDProjectile on it. Without one, nothing happens and nothing logs.
The balance lever. Slow enough and fast enemies outrun the shot.

gotchas.title: Projectiles are instantiated, not pooled
gotchas.body: A field of fast-firing towers creates and destroys a lot of objects. Pooling is the fix if it shows up in the profiler.
